validity.recommendation: Rename to "Haradh–Hawiyah Gas Pipeline (Free Flow Pipelines)", add "Madrakah–Al Hawiyah Gas Pipeline" to OtherEnglishNames; correct StartState/Province and EndState/Province from Makkah to Eastern Province (Ash Sharqiyah); correct FuelSource from "Madrakah" to "Haradh field"; set endpoints Haradh field → Hawiyah Gas Plant.
validity.researcher_notes: The row is a real pipeline but is mislabeled and mis-located. It is Aramco's Free Flow Pipelines project (part of the Haradh & Hawiyah Gas Increment program): ~450 km of pipeline network installed by early 2019 to free-flow 290 MMSCFD from the Haradh field to the Hawiyah Gas Plant, both in the Eastern Province. Every source the sheet itself cites is about HARADH (حرض) and Hawiyah, not 'Madrakah': the gem.wiki outbound refs include offshore-technology.com's 'Haradh–Hawiyah Gas gas pipeline' profile, aawsat.com 'أرامكو... معامل ضغط الغاز في حرض والحوية' (Haradh and Hawiyah), and oilnewsagency 'حرض والحوية'. 'Madrakah' appears to be a misreading of 'Haradh' (حرض), and the endpoints were then wrongly geolocated to Makkah-province places (there is a separate Al Hawiyah town near Taif in Makkah, and a Madrakah north of Jeddah) instead of the Eastern-Province Ghawar facilities. offshore-technology.com/GlobalData explicitly places both endpoints in the Eastern Province; MEED-derived METenders states 'from Haradh field to Hawiyah Gas Plant'. Operator/Owner = Saudi Aramco is correct (offshore-technology, Saudi Gazette).

validity.recommendation: Review StartYear1=2024 (Free Flow Pipelines were installed by early 2019; 2024 likely bled in from the later Haradh/Hawiyah gas-compression and Hawiyah gas-storage news). Review SegmentCost=$4,500,000,000: that is the aggregate value of the multiple oil & gas megaprojects Aramco signed in Nov-2017, NOT the cost of this single pipeline — remove or heavily caveat.
validity.researcher_notes: Two spec problems. (1) StartYear1=2024: METenders/MEED says the Free Flow Pipelines network was to be installed 'by early 2019' to bridge gas supply until the compression plants finished; offshore-technology's '2024 commencement' is a stale GlobalData tracking field. The 2024 date and the attaqa.net 2024 ref (first Saudi gas-STORAGE project at Hawiyah, Unayzah reservoir — a different project) appear to have been conflated onto this pipeline row. Recommend StartYear ~2019, verify before applying. (2) SegmentCost $4.5B: the sheet's own oilnewsagency ref and the Aramco/OGJ Nov-2017 announcement describe '$4.5 billion' as the total for a PORTFOLIO of megaprojects ('Aramco signs contracts totaling $4.5 billion for megaprojects'), not for this pipeline alone. url_verifier confirms the $4.5B figure is not present as this line's cost. Misattributed aggregate.

validity.recommendation: Keep the row (real, distinct, correctly gas). Not a duplicate of the Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah lines. Apply the name/region/spec corrections above.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE confirmed: multiple independent origins (GlobalData/offshore-technology, MEED/METenders, Saudi Gazette, OGJ, plus Aramco's own program pages) describe the Haradh–Hawiyah Free Flow Pipelines. CLASSIFICATION: correctly gas transmission (free-flow non-associated gas, field-to-plant), consistent with how GEM lists other SA field-to-plant lines; minor caveat that it is upstream free-flow rather than sales-gas trunk. DUPLICATE check: NOT a duplicate. P1917/P1918/P1919 'Haradh Khuff-Hawiyah' (43 km, 30 in) are short Khuff-reservoir lines; P1905 Haradh-Uthmaniya (140 km) is a different route; this is the ~450 km free-flow NETWORK (Haradh field→Hawiyah Gas Plant). No confident GulfPub counterpart in the SA gas roster (GulfPub's Haradh-area entries are the East-West/MGS lines and Abqaiq/Qatif lines, not this). SPEC corroborated: LengthKnown=450 km matches offshore-technology ('450km-long') and METenders ('around 450 kilometres of pipeline network') — note this is a NETWORK total, straight-line Haradh→Hawiyah is only ~100 km. Capacity 290 MMcf/d matches METenders/MEED ('free flowing 290 MMSCFD'). Diameter was blank in GEM; sources give 36 in (max) — staged as a fill.

fills.researcher_notes: Diameter was blank. offshore-technology (GlobalData) gives 'maximum diameter of 36 inches'; METenders/MEED corroborates the Free Flow Pipelines spec. Value is the MAX diameter of the network (multi-diameter), so record 36 with that caveat.

Capacity value 290 MMcf/d was present but had no [ref]. METenders/MEED states the network free-flows '290 MMSCFD from Haradh field to Hawiyah Gas Plant', matching the GEM value. Single strong source (the 290 figure traces to the MEED/Aramco project description) → medium; note MMSCFD (standard) vs MMcf/d unit nuance.

Operator = Saudi Aramco, unreferenced in the operators/owners tab. offshore-technology lists 'Saudi Arabian Oil (Saudi Aramco)' as operator/owner; Saudi Gazette confirms Aramco awarded and operates the Haradh/Hawiyah development. Same ref supports Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100%.
Owner = Saudi Aramco 100%, unreferenced. Corroborated by offshore-technology (owner Saudi Aramco) and Saudi Gazette (Aramco-owned Haradh/Hawiyah gas development).

routes.start_name: Haradh field / Haradh Gas Plant area, Eastern Province (Ash Sharqiyah), Saudi Arabia
routes.end_name: Hawiyah Gas Plant, Ghawar / Al-Ahsa, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
routes.corridor_desc: Corrects the current sheet's Makkah-province endpoints (start 'Makkah', end 'Al Hawiyah'/'Makkah'), which are wrong — both real endpoints are in the Eastern Province along the southern-to-central Ghawar field trend. The line runs north from the Haradh field/gas-plant area (southern Ghawar, ~24.14N 49.08E; Haradh town/field coords well sourced) up to the Hawiyah Gas Plant (central Ghawar near Al-Hofuf/Al-Ahsa). Straight-line separation is only ~90-100 km; the cited 450 km is the total FREE-FLOW NETWORK length (multiple gathering/trunk lines and loops feeding wells to the plant), so the corridor is a field-wide network, not a single point-to-point route. Start coord is sourced (Haradh field 24.1358/49.0782, Haradh wells 24.2417/49.1864). End coord for the Hawiyah Gas Plant is APPROXIMATE (placed in the Ghawar/Al-Ahsa area north of Haradh, ~24.96N 49.30E) — no precise facility coordinate could be verified, so treat as a loose bound, not a surveyed point.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints re-established from independent sources: offshore-technology/GlobalData ('start Eastern Province → end Eastern Province') and METenders/MEED ('Haradh field to Hawiyah Gas Plant'). This is a hard correction to the current Makkah geolocation. Haradh start coordinate is sourced; Hawiyah Gas Plant end coordinate is an approximate placement in the Ghawar/Al-Ahsa area (no exact plant coordinate verified — NOT fabricated precision, flagged as loose). Geometry remains low because 450 km is a network total, not a definable single-route corridor.

summary: P3961 is real (Aramco Haradh–Hawiyah Free Flow Pipelines, ~450 km/290 MMSCFD/36in, Eastern Province, op ~2019) but mislabeled: name 'Madrakah–Al Hawiyah' is a Haradh misreading, region wrongly Makkah, FuelSource wrong; StartYear 2024 and $4.5B cost misattributed; diameter filled 36in.
